The role requires a dynamic leader who can inspire teams, foster a DevOps culture, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and secure software solutions.Key interactions• Reporting to VP Engineering.• Collaborate with the Engineering Leadership Team.• Work closely with Product Managers, Delivery Leads, Architects, and other key business and technology stakeholders.Key Areas of Responsibility/AccountabilityLeadership and Strategy:o Provide strategic leadership and vision for the engineering function.o Collaborate across the company to align software development goals with overall business objectives and ensure these the teams are aware of these.o Develop and implement software development policies, procedures, and standards.o Work closely with the Engineering Leadership team to continue to develop and implement with Engineering Operating Model and ensuring its alignment with key strategic goals and objectives.Team Management:o Lead, mentor, and inspire multiple teams of engineers, architects, and other technical professionals.o Foster a collaborative and innovative team culture.o Facilitate professional development and growth opportunities for team members.Project Management, working closely with the Delivery Leadership Team:o Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from concept to delivery.o Working with Delivery Leads and Product Managers to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.o Manage project budgets, resource allocation, and risk mitigation in collaboration with the Delivery team.Technical Oversight:o Define and enforce coding standards, development methodologies, and best practices.o Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, making recommendations for adoption.o Ensure the security, scalability, and maintainability of software systems.Collaboration and Communication:Collaborate with Delivery Leads, Architects, Product Managers, UX/UI designers, and other stakeholders to ensure a seamless integration of software solutions.o Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.o Provide regular updates on project status and performance metrics.Quality Assurance:o Working closely with the Head of Quality Assurance to ensure robust testing processes delivering quality software.o Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for software development.Budget and Resource Management:o Develop and manage the engineering budget, ensuring efficient allocation of resources.o Manage 3rd party suppliers using the Informa supplier management framework and tools to ensure compliance with our internal standards.Key Outputs and OutcomesProduct Innovation:o Drive the development of innovative and market-leading software productso Contribute to the organization's competitive advantage through technological advancements.Project Success:o Ensure the on-time and on-budget delivery of software projects, meeting or exceeding quality standards.Stakeholder Satisfaction:o Foster positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring their needs are met and expectations are exceeded.Risk Mitigation: o Identify and proactively mitigate risks related to software development projects and technical operations.Operational Efficiency:o Improve overall software development efficiency through process optimization and the adoption of best practices.Revenue Growth:o Contribute to the organization's growth by delivering software solutions that meet customer needs and drive market expansion.Technical Leadership:o Elevate the technical capabilities of the organization, positioning it as a leader in the industry.Measures of Success• Delivery Timeliness: Percentage of projects delivered on time, demonstrating effectiveplanning and execution.• Quality of Deliverables: Low defect density and minimal post-release issues, ensuring high-quality software products.• Team Performance: High team productivity and colleague engagement, reflecting a positive and collaborative team environment.• Innovation and Technology Adoption: Adoption of new technologies and innovative solutions that drive competitive advantage.Budget Adherence: Efficient management of financial resources, ensuring projects are delivered within budget.• Stakeholder Satisfaction: Positive feedback from internal and external stakeholders, reflecting alignment with business needs.• Technical Debt Reduction: Measurable reduction in technical debt, improving system scalability and maintainability.What we’re looking for We are seeking a dynamic and strategic leader with a proven track record of guiding engineering teams to success. The ideal candidate will have:• A strong technical background with experience leading multiple engineering teams across diverse technologies.• A collaborative, people-focused leadership style with a passion for team building and professional development.• Expertise in Agile methodologies and a DevOps mindset, ensuring teams operate with a "you build it, you support it" philosophy.• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.• A results-oriented approach, with the ability to navigate complex challenges and deliver innovative solutions.• Financial acumen and experience managing budgets and vendor relationships.• A customer-focused mindset, ensuring software solutions meet business needs and drive market growth. preferred.Minimum 8 years of relevant programmatic ad tech work experience in the digital advertising industry, including in-depth knowledge of areas such as Google AdMob, Google Ad Manager, SSP & DSP performance optimization and reporting skills.Very strong analytical thinking abilities, project management, and organization skills.Ability to present clear project plans and communicate with teams to reach desired results.Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) preferred.Ability to work flexible hours (generally local business hours except for meetings that overlap with US (California) mornings).QualificationBCA/B.Tech/B.E./MCA graduation degree or equivalent from a well-known institute/university.Additional InformationReturn to Office: PubMatic employees normalizedText: About ZOOM Communications:Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Gurugram, ZOOM Communications is South Asia's largest Outdoor Broadcast Systems, Solutions, Services and Integration company. With over three decades of illustrious track record, ZOOM has firmly established itself as an Asian broadcasting powerhouse with a strong global imprint.ZOOM has served a diverse clientele spanning Sports Federations, Host Broadcasters, Rights Holders, Broadcast Networks, News Networks and the Public Sector. Its core service verticals include:· Outside Broadcast (OB) & Flyaway/Flypack Operations – From analog to UHD/4K, including Super Slow-Motion and IP-based broadcast technologies· Systems Integration – Turnkey long-term installations and Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) facility management for broadcast networks· Equipment Hire – Dry and wet hire of state-of-the-art HD/UHD broadcast equipment globally· Content Creation – Feature films, documentaries, and infotainment content for television, OTT, corporates, and advertisingSome of ZOOM's landmark engagements include but are not limited to the Olympic Games (Summer & Winter), FIFA events (including FIFA U-17 World Cup 2017), Asian Games (Jakarta 2018), Commonwealth Games 2010, Pan American Games, Indian Premier League (IPL), the Indian Super League (ISL), Women's Premier League (WPL), Tamil Nadu Premier League (TNPL), National Games, Big Boss, Indian Idol, and the build-out of studios for India's leading news channels.About the RoleWe are seeking an entrepreneurial, seasoned, strategically oriented Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join our leadership team at ZOOM Communications. The CFO, a key member of a rapidly growing executive team, will drive financial strategy, governance, capital allocation, and long-term value creation. This is a high-impact role suited for a finance leader with a proven track record in large organisations and exposure to capital markets, M&A, and international financial risk management.Location: GurugramReporting To: Chief Operating OfficerEngagement Type: Full-TimeTeam Size: 7–10 Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:1. Financial Strategy & Business Partnership:· Define and own the company's long-term financial strategy in alignment with overall business goals· Serve as a strategic co-pilot to the executive team, providing data-driven analysis and insights for major business decisions, including capital allocation, geographic expansion, and new business initiatives· Lead financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting cycles; present financial performance and outlook to the Board· Evaluate and recommend optimal capital structure, balancing growth ambition with cost of capital2. Fundraising – Debt & Private Equity:· Lead and manage the entire lifecycle of debt fundraising: working capital, term loans, ECB, NCDs, and structured finance instruments· Drive private equity fundraising processes, including preparation of investment materials, management presentations, financial models, and deal negotiations· Build and maintain strong relationships with banks, NBFCs, PE/VC investors, DFIs, and credit rating agencies· Manage banking covenants, compliance with lender obligations, and timely financial reporting to debt providers3. IPO Preparedness:· Lead end-to-end IPO readiness assessment, financial restatements, and compliance with SEBI, ICDR, and LODR regulations· Coordinate preparation of the Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with investment bankers, legal advisors, auditors, and merchant bankers· Oversee investor roadshows, analyst briefings, and pre-IPO governance framework upgrades· Establish robust disclosure practices, board reporting standards, and investor communication protocols aligned with public company requirements4. Mergers, Acquisitions & Due Diligence:· Drive M&A origination support, target evaluation, financial due diligence, valuation, and integration planning· Lead financial and commercial due diligence for inbound and outbound transactions; manage data rooms and liaise with advisors· Assess synergies, integration risks, and post-merger financial consolidation5. Foreign Currency (FCY) Hedging & Treasury:· Formulate and implement FCY risk management policy; actively manage the company's foreign exchange exposure through appropriate hedging instruments (forwards, options, swaps)· Oversee treasury operations, liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and investment of surplus funds· Monitor global macroeconomic and currency trends and advise leadership on treasury risk strategies6. Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit:· Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with Ind AS.· Ensure compliance with Companies Act 2013, FEMA, Income Tax (TDS, Advance Tax etc), GST.· Oversee statutory audits, tax audits, and internal audits; manage relationships with Big 6 / Big 4 audit firms and ensure clean audit outcomes· Lead and manage the transition from Indian GAAP to Ind AS, ensuring full compliance with the applicable convergence roadmap and disclosures.· Oversee secretarial compliance, ROC filings, related-party transaction governance, and coordination with the Company Secretary function.7. ERP & Technology Leadership:· Lead enterprise-wide ERP implementation and upgrades ensuring finance process automation and data integrity.· Leverage Generative AI and advanced analytics tools to enhance financial reporting, scenario planning, forecasting, and audit efficiency.· Champion digital transformation initiatives in the finance function, including automation of reconciliations, month-end close, and management information systems.8. Risk Management & Governance:· Build and maintain a robust internal control framework, including SOPs, risk registers, and audit committee reporting.· Identify financial, operational, regulatory, and reputational risks; develop mitigation strategies and present risk dashboards.· Ensure strong corporate governance practices in line with Companies Act, and international best practices9. Team & Stakeholder Leadership:· Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing Finance & Accounts team across functions including accounting, taxation, treasury, FP&A, and compliance· Manage and develop relationships with key external stakeholders: auditors, banks, PE/VC investors, regulators, rating agencies, and legal advisorsRequired Qualifications & Experience:· Total Experience: Minimum 18 years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts· Leadership Tenure: Minimum 2 years as CFO, Deputy CFO, or Head of Finance & Accounts· Company Size: Experience in companies with an annual turnover exceeding ₹1,000 Crore· Debt Fundraising: Demonstrated track record in raising debt (vanilla & structured) – working capital, term loans, ECB, NCDs, PTCs etc.· PE Fundraising: Hands-on experience in private equity fundraising, PE & IB firms relationships, and deal execution· IPO Preparedness: Experience of leading/being part of team involved in IPO Preparedness.· Ind AS / GAAP Transition: Proven experience in transitioning financial reporting from Indian GAAP to Ind AS· FCY Hedging: Active exposure to foreign currency risk management and hedging strategies· M&A / Due Diligence: End-to-end M&A experience including financial due diligence and integration· ERP Implementation: Experience in leading at least one full-cycle ERP implementation· Big 6 Auditor Handling: Proven experience of managing Big 6 / Big 4 auditors· Gen AI Familiarity: Working knowledge of Generative AI tools and their applicability in finance functionsEducational Qualifications:Mandatory: Chartered Accountant (CA) – ICAI. Added Advantage: 1. MBA (Finance) from a reputed institution is an additional qualification2. Qualified Company Secretary (CS) – ICSI3. Prior experience of working in a B2B / B2G organization 4. role: Director of Engineering Consumer Intelligence & Engagement
normalizedText: SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.YOUR MISSION:The Director of Engineering - Consumer Intelligence & Engagement is a product-aligned technology leader with direct accountability for engineering delivery across the capabilities that define how consumers discover, engage with, and respond to our brand. This role owns the full product technology lifecycle, from architecture decisions and roadmap execution to engineering standards and platform health.Your organisation is the layer of intelligence and engagement that activates our core commerce capabilities: shaping what consumers see, how content reaches them, how products are discovered, and how campaigns convert. AI is a key enabler across this organisation: you will apply AI to enhance personalisation, accelerate content workflows, improve product discovery, and build smarter campaign targeting, but strong software engineering depth across these product domains remains the primary craft.As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office-based and require regular in-person collaboration to accelerate decision-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world-class engineering capability from the ground up.Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:Personalisation - consumer segmentation, behavioural targeting, AI-driven product recommendations, and next-best-action experiences.Content Management - content modelling, authoring workflows, and multi-channel distribution via headless CMS (Sanity); AI-assisted content enrichment and generation.Product Detail & Listing Pages (PDP/PLP) - page architecture, attribute rendering, media delivery, sorting, filtering, and AI-enhanced product presentation.Product Discovery - search (keyword and AI-assisted semantic), browse, faceted navigation, and ranking logic.Consumer Communication - email, push notifications, SMS, and in-app messaging delivery, personalisation, and orchestration.Promotions & Campaigns – personalised promotions, offer management, campaign targeting, scheduling, and performance instrumentation.Technology Vision & Product Roadmap DeliveryOwn the technology strategy and engineering roadmap across all Consumer Intelligence & Engagement capabilities, in close partnership with the product organisation.Act as the primary technology partner to product owners and business stakeholders including participating in discovery, sprint planning, OKR definition, and roadmap prioritisation.Drive end-to-end delivery accountability: architecture decisions, engineering execution, quality assurance, release management, and production health across the full capability portfolio.Make principled build/configure/integrate decisions across the stack by balancing SFCC platform capabilities, Sanity content workflows, GraphQL API design, and custom development.Establish a technology vision that progressively embeds AI as an engineering accelerator and product differentiator across each capability domain.Personalisation & Product Discovery EngineeringLead the engineering design and delivery of personalisation capabilities such as consumer segmentation logic, affinity modelling integrations, and real-time recommendation surfaces on PDP, PLP, homepage, and campaign pages.Own the product discovery engineering stack: search indexing, query understanding, faceted navigation, and results ranking - integrating AI-powered relevance signals to measurably improve discovery outcomes.Build the technical foundation for A/B testing, multivariate experimentation, and feature flagging across personalisation and discovery surfaces, enabling rigorous data-driven optimisation.Define and own the data contract between consumer event infrastructure and personalisation/ranking systems, including schema standards, latency requirements, and completeness in partnership with data engineering and analytics.Content Management & PDP/PLP EngineeringOwn the engineering of content management infrastructure including Sanity CMS content modelling, editorial workflows, content delivery APIs, and multi-channel distribution.Lead PDP and PLP engineering: page composition, product attribute rendering, media and asset delivery, enriched content blocks, and SEO-critical technical requirements.Leverage AI to accelerate and enrich content workflows - automated product description generation, attribute enrichment, image tagging, and content QA tooling built on top of LLM APIs.Ensure content and product page experiences are performant, accessible, and composable by building reusable ReactJS front-end components that other product teams can extend.Promotions, Campaigns & Consumer CommunicationsLead the engineering of promotions and campaign management - rules engine configuration and extension within SFCC, offer scheduling, eligibility logic, and storefront rendering of promotional content.Own the technical architecture for consumer communication systems - integration with messaging platforms (email, push, SMS), personalisation of communication content, and event-triggered automation.Apply AI to campaign and promotions engineering: intelligent audience segmentation, send-time optimisation, and AI-assisted copy generation for targeted consumer communications.Instrument campaigns and promotions with robust analytics and tracking, ensuring business teams have accurate, real-time visibility into performance and conversion.AI-Enabled EngineeringChampion AI as a pragmatic engineering enabler using AI-assisted development tools, automated testing, and code generation to increase engineering velocity and code quality.Identify high-value opportunities to integrate AI capabilities into product features: semantic search, AI-generated content, intelligent product recommendations, and dynamic campaign personalisation.Embed responsible AI practices - transparency, bias awareness, and consumer data privacy into any AI-powered consumer-facing feature from the outset.Architecture, Standards & GovernanceDefine and govern the software architecture for all capability domains, ensuring solutions are scalable, composable, and well-integrated with the shared commerce technology platform.Own the GraphQL API layer for capability domains - schema design, query performance, versioning, and contract governance with consuming front-end teams.Establish and enforce engineering standards across the organisation: code quality, testing practices, API design, accessibility, performance budgets, and deployment processes.Manage APIGEE integration for capability APIs - ensuring consistent security, rate limiting, and developer experience across internal and external API consumers.Partner closely with the Consumer Experience Engineering organisation to align on shared components, design system usage, and front-end standards.Team Leadership & Stakeholder EngagementLead, mentor, and grow a team of senior engineers and manage delivery partners.Foster a product engineering culture - engineers who take ownership of outcomes, not just outputs, and who engage deeply with consumer and business problems.Build strong working relationships with Product, UX, Marketing, Merchandising, and Data teams to ensure engineering is a genuine business partner across all capability areas.YOUR TALENT:Key Requirements:15+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior engineering leadership with direct product delivery accountability.Strong front-end and full-stack engineering background - hands-on proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript, and GraphQL(GQL).Proven track record delivering e-commerce product capabilities - PDP/PLP, product discovery, content management, promotions, or consumer communications in a DTC or retail environment.Deep familiarity with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) - commerce APIs, catalogue management, promotions framework, and extension patterns.Deep architectural & implementation expertise with headless CMS platforms, particularly Sanity content modelling, and editorial workflow design.Experience integrating AI capabilities into consumer-facing products such as recommendations, search relevance, content generation, or personalisation features via API-based services.Solid grasp of API management (APIGEE or equivalent) and composable, microservices-based architecture.Track record of building and governing engineering standards across multi-team product organisations.Experience in fashion, sports, or lifestyle retail DTC organisations.Background with search and merchandising platforms and personalisation engines.Familiarity with marketing automation and communications platforms.Working knowledge of AI/LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models) applied to content enrichment or commerce use cases.Key Technologies:Front-End: ReactJS, TypeScript, Next.js, GraphQL (GQL)Commerce Platform: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC / PWA Kit / SCAPI)CMS & Content: Sanity (headless), GROQ, content modelling, AI content workflowsAPI Management: APIGEE, REST, GraphQL schema design & governanceSearch & Discovery: Elasticsearch faceted search, AI-assisted rankingPersonalisation: Recommendation engine integrations, segmentation, A/B testing toolingCommunications: Email / push / SMS platform integrations, event-triggered automationAI Integration: LLM APIs for content generation, semantic search, personalisation signalsPromotions: SFCC promotions framework, rules engine, campaign scheduling & analyticsLeadership Expectations:At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.Strategic Thinking & VisionTranslate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.Ownership & AccountabilityTake end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a relentless focus on results.Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.People & Team LeadershipBuild, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.Collaboration & Stakeholder ManagementBuild strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.Demonstrate confidence in decision-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.Lead with a team-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.Innovation & Continuous LearningChampion modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.Commercial & Consumer MindsetUnderstand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.Maintain a strong consumer-first The position of ‘Director of Revenue Management – India & SWA’ will be responsible for driving the continued development and growth of revenue and profits for the portfolio hotels and run an efficient revenue organization for the region, and provide best-in-class recruitment, and training and best practices across hotels. This role will provide key leadership surrounding the hotel's revenue recognition policies and will regularly collaborate with the sales operations and different marketing organizations to bring best decisions at the forefront. The position is also responsible for the cluster organizations set-up in India & SWA.OperationalWorking in close collaboration with the Commercial Services team in achieving the key commercial KPIs for the region.To assist management of new hotels in India & SWA and coordinate with Global Contact Center of the hotel set-up for optimal revenue performance.To provide guidance to the Area Revenue resources and the hotels to maximize occupancy and revenue generation through pricing strategies and proper inventory management.To actively drive annual business planning processes in coordination with other function heads.To determine, implement and monitor measurable growth strategies through distribution channels.To ensure strategic and operational compliance to all Hyatt revenue management best practices and business strategies.To provide ongoing analysis and feedback to hotels on effectiveness of past and future revenue management strategies and market trends.To maintain, update and support the pro-active and re-active communication process designed for ASPAC - SWA to disseminate consistent and relevant Revenue Management ASPAC - SWA principles and techniques to all Revenue Management Specialists across India & SWA.To work closely with third party distribution channels and Hyatt distribution teams to ensure hotels are available to sell in channels and OTAs that add value to our network.To work with various distribution groups, strategic, and implementation groups to ensure SWA hotels are distributed strategically in their regions and are promoted on an on-going basis.To ensure that “Total Revenue Management” is practiced in all hotels within region and to work towards further enhancing the business practices surrounding Total RM.FinancialTo work with the Regional Vice President Revenue Strategy for ASPAC - SWA on the annual budget and ensure that all costs are strictly controlled.To monitor RevPar competitiveness and provide direction to hotels to maximize RevPar growth.To evaluate the success of promotions and other tactics aimed at increasing RevPar.To set in place integrated solutions to enable the hotels to focus on revenue engineering at all profit centers in each hotel and improve efficiency in cost control.To provide Regional Senior Management with key performance indicators and insight into business and market trends.Provide guidance to the Area / hotel teams to help them achieve RGI related performance tests as applicable.TechnologyTo maintain and update business processes resulting from new analytical and revenue management technology.To provide feedback to the Regional Vice President Revenue Strategy for ASPAC - The Head of Engineering (SVP) will be a pivotal member of our executive team, driving the company's technology strategy and execution. This role demands a leader with a deep understanding of the technological landscape within the financial services industry, exemplary project management skills, and a proven track record in fostering high-performance teams while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. Key Responsibilities: Chart out and execute a forward-looking technology strategy that aligns with the company’s goals, emphasizing scalability, security, and customer-centric innovation. Lead the transition towards a microservices-based architecture, ensuring the architecture supports scalability, maintenance, and compliance with ISO, PCI-DSS. Manage the technology team’s operational activities, promoting a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and technological excellence. Develop and implement advanced cybersecurity and data protection strategies to protect company and customer data against emerging threats, ensuring full compliance with regulatory requirements. Direct the recruitment, training, and development of the technology team to nurture talent and encourage professional growth, creating a dynamic and skilled team. Work closely with executive peers to develop technology solutions that enhance customer engagement, operational efficiency, and competitive edge. Keep abreast of new technology trends and best practices, evaluating and adopting new technologies where they offer strategic advantages. Oversee the creation, implementation, and maintenance of company-wide technology policies and standards, including disaster recovery and business continuity plans. Manage the technology budget, ensuring strategic allocation of resources and cost-effective technology investments. Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a relevant technical field. Over 10 years of technology leadership experience, with a significant portion within the financial services industry, ideally in an NBFC or banking context. Demonstrated success in leading significant technology transformation initiatives, including adopting microservices architectures. In-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks relevant to the financial industry, such as ISO, PCI-DSS, and NPCI. Proven leadership skills with a track record of building, mentoring, and retaining high-caliber technology teams. Exceptional strategic, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of conveying complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholder Work Location: In person

About this role: Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities, then uncovering opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers own and drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure. They then transition new clients to the account management team for ongoing value delivery. Our Business Development teams are relentless about building trust-based, value add relationships with clients, delivering long-term client value, and building their book of business over time. Business developers are results driven, client committed, and highly collaborative. Business Developers will be given a territory of Large Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. In our End-User Large Enterprise segment, Business Developers work with prospects with +$1bil in annual revenue. In our Technology Vendor Large Enterprise segment, Business Developers work with prospects with +$500mil in annual revenue. What you will do:Seek out and drive new business opportunities with new-to-Gartner organizations across your territory, from initial client outreach to close, targeting Large Enterprise C-Level stakeholders. Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team. Align the right combination of insight, guidance and practical tools to bring value to the partnership. Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics ensuring KPI’s are met. Quota responsibility for your assigned territory. Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments. Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis. What you will need:5+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments. Business development or new client-acquisition experience in a selling role highly desiredExperience selling to and/or influencing C-level executives. Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets. Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process. Willingness to conduct travel as needed. Bachelor's degree preferredProgression within Business Development Executive Roles: Gartner offers a lifetime of opportunities driven by our growth. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. Gartner has a promote from within culture and limitless opportunities for progression. Gartner leaders embrace this culture and are focused on helping associates achieve success in current role, as well as coaching associates to the next role or path, whether it be more senior BD levels, account management paths, or sales leadership. Typical internal promotions include:Business Development DirectorTeam LeadSales ManagerMost of our Sales Managers and Team Leads are hired internally as part of our progression path. What you will get:Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!Uncapped commission structureWorld-class sales training programs and skill development programsAnnual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performersCollaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusionProfessional development and career growth opportunitiesWho are we? At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.What makes Gartner a great place to work? Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.Gartner is the world authority on AIAt Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.What do we offer? Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. ResponsibilitiesVice President, Product DesignerWe’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Product Designer to join our Digital Channels team. This role is based in Pune.In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:We are seeking a Senior Product Designer with experience working with, defining, and designing complex systems to bring creativity, strategic insight, and user-centered thinking to our team. This role requires an individual who excels in collaboration, design execution, and the ability to drive impactful user experiences.The Ideal Candidate Will Bring The Following Expertise CraftUser-Centered Design – Lead with a user-first approach, ensuring all design choices address user needs, behaviors, and insights from research. Drive a seamless and intuitive product experience by deeply understanding our users.Journey Mapping – Map and analyze end-to-end user journeys across customers, operations, servicing teams and systems to identify pain points, key moments, and opportunities for improvement. Use journey maps to align teams on a shared vision of user needs, ensuring a cohesive and supportive experience at each stage.Interaction and UI Design – Demonstrates mastery in designing complex web interfaces and workflows, creating products that are both highly functional and visually engaging. Skilled in developing intuitive layouts, navigation patterns, and interaction models for intricate systems. Thoughtfully uses animation and micro-interactions to guide users, making complex tasks more approachable and enhancing the overall product experience.Proficiency in Design Tools – Possess advanced skills in tools such as Figma and Miro, to create high-fidelity wireframes, prototypes, and mockups that clearly communicate interaction models and UI specifications.Systems thinkingDesign System Knowledge – Experience with and contribute to a global design system that ensures visual consistency across interfaces. Develop workflow patterns and components that can then be reused by other teams.Complex Systems Knowledge – Bring an understanding of the unique challenges of designing and maintaining complex systems, with an ability to distill intricate requirements into clear design solutions that facilitate user understanding and interaction.Collaboration and CommunicationCross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to align design efforts with business goals, transforming complex requirements into clear, functional design solutions that respect technical constraints.Effective Communication and Storytelling – Articulate design concepts and rationale to diverse stakeholders, making complex ideas accessible. Use storytelling to engage others in the product vision, fostering alignment and enthusiasm.Mentorship and LeadershipSkilled in guiding junior designers, providing constructive feedback, and elevating team standards. Fosters a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration within the team.A portfolio is required to be considered for this positionThis portfolio should demonstrate some or most of the expertise described above. While process is extremely important, a portfolio should demonstrate a high-quality end product that you’re proud of leading. A portfolio could include a Figma link that’s open to view access.To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:Typically, a candidate at this level has 12+ years of experience and some previous experience in regulated spaces like finance, health or insurance.About UsAt BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.About The TeamAt BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedInHere’s a Few Of Our Recent AwardsAmerica’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025“Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025Our Benefits And RewardsBNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.
